limitations: CPU audit scripts are synthetic and use DOM/texture atlas substitutes. Native tests use real WebGL.
Initial baseline native session used pre-storage/streaming-stats harness; benchmark route, core timing and graphics are unchanged.
The 256-plant case is an artificial worst-case garden, not typical world vegetation.
averageFps in CPU/GPU/operation summaries is inverse cost, not gameplay FPS; use frame.averageFps only.
Native gameplay scenarios are single paired runs; storage has three consecutive writes per size in one process, not three independent sessions.
Storage heartbeat first segment is partial and can be negative; do not derive FPS or worst stall from its summary. Independent submit/total/load timers are used.
512-chunk async completion remains slower despite lower main-thread submit cost; 128-chunk reads remain slower. Final saved-block map remains fully resident.
Runtime scene evidence uses actual per-run source commits; later storage-only changes do not change the measured generator/mesher.
No physical Android device was tested.
